lessons.key: gate_fail::when a check says a filter applies per database or per scope give the fixture the same entity in two scopes and assert the other scope is unaffected and pick names that cannot appear as substrings of other fields
lessons.text: When a check says a filter applies per database (or per scope), give the fixture the same entity in two scopes and assert the other scope is unaffected, and pick names that cannot appear as substrings of other fields.

lessons.key: gate_fail::put a component s display and lock decisions inside the child that renders them and pass raw parent state as props so a mount test exercises the decision instead of a value hard coded in the test
lessons.text: Put a component's display and lock decisions inside the child that renders them and pass raw parent state as props, so a mount test exercises the decision instead of a value hard-coded in the test.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::for a display rule combining several guards default locked loaded has match give each guard a fixture where only that guard decides the outcome including the no match variant of every state
lessons.text: For a display rule combining several guards (default, locked, loaded, has-match), give each guard a fixture where only that guard decides the outcome, including the no-match variant of every state.

lessons.key: gate_fail::keep apostrophes and other shell sensitive characters out of vitest test names used as t selectors through yarn and electron they are lost and the selector silently matches nothing
lessons.text: Keep apostrophes and other shell-sensitive characters out of vitest test names used as -t selectors; through yarn and electron they are lost and the selector silently matches nothing.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a claim says every entity include at least one routine in the fixture not only tables
lessons.text: When a claim says every entity, include at least one routine in the fixture, not only tables.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a component draws state from a derived value isopen expanded openedbyfilter assert the derived value or the rendered markup never only the stored flag
lessons.text: When a component draws state from a derived value (isOpen = expanded || openedByFilter), assert the derived value or the rendered markup, never only the stored flag.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::for provide inject wiring run the real provider s provide above a child built on the real mixin a test that injects the value itself proves nothing about the provider
lessons.text: For provide/inject wiring, run the real provider's provide above a child built on the real mixin; a test that injects the value itself proves nothing about the provider.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::build store fixtures with every field the real store always sets e g a connection s default database or a mutant that branches on that field survives
lessons.text: Build store fixtures with every field the real store always sets (e.g. a connection's default database), or a mutant that branches on that field survives.
